headline: Ten Nifty 500 stocks plunge up to 58% over the past year
hook: Heavy wealth erosion in past one year
summary: Ten Nifty 500 stocks have dropped between 47% and 58% over the past year, heavily underperforming the broader market. KEC International, Reliance Power, and KPIT Technologies lead this list of laggards. Nearly 50 stocks within the index have recorded declines exceeding 30% during the same timeframe. Indian retail investors holding underperforming mid and small-cap stocks face ongoing portfolio drag from these sharp corrections.
why_it_matters: Portfolio returns lag if you hold severe index laggards

headline: KPIT Technologies confirms SEBI dematerialisation compliance for Q2 2026
hook: Routine filings from a mid-cap IT player
summary: KPIT Technologies has officially confirmed its SEBI-regulated dematerialisation compliance for the second quarter of 2026. Dematerialisation compliance is a routine regulatory requirement for listed companies in India. This filing ensures the company meets standard depository rules and regulations. Indian retail investors can note this as a procedural update with no direct impact on financial performance.
why_it_matters: Routine regulatory filing with no material impact on share price

headline: Quant Small Cap Fund exits ICICI Bank and adds Adani Power
hook: Quant Small Cap Fund reshuffles portfolio
summary: Quant Small Cap Fund liquidated its entire holding of 4.26 million shares in ICICI Bank during September 2026. The fund also exited five other undisclosed stocks while increasing positions in Adani Power, Emami, and KPIT Technologies. New additions to the portfolio include Max Estates and Moneyview. The fund currently manages an AUM of Rs 35,572 crore.
why_it_matters: Signals shifting sentiment in a major small-cap mutual fund.
winners_losers: Adani Power gains / ICICI Bank hurt

headline: Inox Wind, Tata Elxsi and other retail favorites trade near 52-week lows
hook: Popular retail counters sink near annual floors
summary: Several high-profile retail favorite stocks, including Inox Wind, Tata Elxsi, KPIT Tech, Jupiter Wagons, and RVNL, are experiencing a sharp correction. These counters are currently trading near their 52-week lows during the session. Such a broad-based drop among popular retail holdings signals growing downside pressure in mid-cap and small-cap segments. Indian retail investors holding these momentum stocks face heightened volatility and potential capital erosion.
why_it_matters: Your portfolio holdings may face deeper downside risk
winners_losers: Short sellers gain / retail investors hurt

headline: Over half of Nifty 500 stocks have fallen 20% from yearly highs
hook: Majority of Nifty 500 stocks in correction
summary: Indian equity markets are facing a sustained sell-off, with 56% of Nifty 500 constituents now trading at least 20% below their 52-week peaks. The decline is driven by persistent foreign institutional investor (FII) outflows, rising bond yields, and volatile crude oil prices. Major names including Reliance Industries, HDFC Bank, and Infosys are among those caught in the broader market downturn. This trend reflects a significant cooling in investor sentiment across mid-cap and large-cap segments.
why_it_matters: Portfolio values may see deeper drawdowns as broad selling continues.
